instrument_confound.note: The SGMC-extra surrogate cannot pay a dot that sits in the 0-3 px collar of a mapped fault, because its truth is SGMC minus the catalogue. R0 is built almost entirely of such dots, so outward-moving CONCENTRATION arms gain on this instrument partly by construction; each arm is therefore read against its matched random-destination control, not against zero.

b5km-surfext-down10.reading: A CONCENTRATION arm that moves mass outward raises every 'distance to catalogue' column and lowers nothing; compare an arm with its matched random-destination control before attributing any MODEL delta to lineaments.

b5km-surfext-down15.reading: A CONCENTRATION arm that moves mass outward raises every 'distance to catalogue' column and lowers nothing; compare an arm with its matched random-destination control before attributing any MODEL delta to lineaments.

live_credit_budget_projection.model: DTI = T/(alpha*T + alpha*(n-M) + beta*|G|), binary unit dots
live_credit_budget_projection.note: The rearrangement axes move which ~1-4k dots exist, not how much new fault line the field touches; the credit they can buy is bounded by the kernel overlap they change. Read this against the measured |delta| <= 0.008.

hide_and_recover_proxy.protocol: buffered_component_draw(seed=20, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3, boundary_px=12) + symmetric fold-fair rebuild of R0 and every arm from f.visible only
hide_and_recover_proxy.contamination: R0 is rebuilt fold-fair from f.visible; the destination surface is a fixed ancestor field (catalogue-trained) exactly as in the merged b5km-cvband-down4 arm
